contract.historicalActionUsage: Offline label only; never read by runtime Shadow or action selection.

opponentPolicy.interpretation: Every observable nominal policy is uniform within one probability unit, so the current opponent model contributes no useful root-conditioned discrimination on this corpus.

historicalDirection.interpretation: The realized next enemy action and nominal one-step expectation support both improvements and both regressions. Removing ATTACK makes all four realized columns equal, proving that their direction is manufactured by the one-step ATTACK leaf family rather than response discrimination.

structuralCertificate.definition: Objective Pareto dominance plus at least one verified muzzle-coverage, response-viability, escape-branch or counter-exposure gain; generic route PROGRESS alone is excluded.
structuralCertificate.decision: Retain as a strict Shadow certificate only. Coverage is insufficient for action ownership.

retain: FULL and NO_ATTACK cells on the same enemy-response columns
observable nominal policy snapshot as diagnostic data
offline historical action join as a label
strict structural attack progress as a Shadow certificate
reject: historical realized next action as runtime information
one-step response-conditioned scalar value as an action certificate
the current near-uniform nominal opponent policy as an owner
generic route progress as verified attack progress
tuning ATTACK scalar weights from these four directional roots
decision.next: BP138 extends the shared continuation beyond one enemy response to the next attack event or committed deadline. It records terminal/nonloss, shot creation, hit/kill, counter-exposure and escape viability separately; historical actions remain offline labels only.
